request.text: Starting Wednesday, September 2, 2026, remind me every other Wednesday at 8:00 PM to send Noah a check-in message while he settles into his new city, and stop after November 25, 2026.

responsibilities.outcome: Create an every-other-Wednesday reminder at 8:00 PM, active from September 2 through November 25, 2026, to send Noah a check-in message while he settles into his new city.

new_goals.description: Schedule a bounded recurring reminder to check in with Noah while he settles into his new city.
new_goals.source_text: Starting Wednesday, September 2, 2026, remind me every other Wednesday at 8:00 PM to send Noah a check-in message while he settles into his new city, and stop after November 25, 2026.

constraints.reminder_content: Send Noah a check-in message while he settles into his new city.

success_criteria: The recurring reminder is scheduled only for the requested cadence, time, content, and inclusive date interval.

goal_association_resolution.reason_summary: The recurring communication reminder forms one new Goal.

semantic_facts: The proposed recurring Work and confirmation must preserve the September 2 start, every-other-Wednesday cadence, 8:00 PM time, Noah check-in content, and November 25 final occurrence.
The whole series must await confirmation; preparing it does not send any message to Noah.
forbidden_claims: The recurring reminder or any occurrence already exists.
A check-in message has been sent to Noah.
The recurrence has been shortened, extended, or converted to every Wednesday.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: The apparent completeness of a recurring schedule causes the confirmation boundary to be skipped.
Recurrence material is dropped or normalized into a different cadence while converting the Goal into Work.
